findings.evidence: A5, R7 and AC38 (R7, A5) cover resolved absolute paths through explicit arguments, the runtime environment variable and the derived default, requiring status_path_collision and non-zero exit before binding or writing, with unchanged configuration bytes verified; no refusal-route gap remains.

R7 and AC39 establish non-crashing, distinct unusable-record reporting, unknown drift and no inferred readiness, including unreadable and wrong-shape JSON tests; however, R7 leaves the types/formats of start time, sequence, digest and the per-module container undefined, and omits the overall state used by Apply and AC33 from its required-field list, so incomplete/wrongly typed record classification remains underspecified and the specification is not yet sound enough to plan from.
